I have implemented the requested changes on a new branch `fix/persister-restore-state` and committed all changes:

1. **Added [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L81-L96) in `@tanstack/query-core`**:
   - Exported [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-core/src/index.ts#L54-L64), [`isPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L98-L107), and [`createRestoredQueryState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L794-L845) from `@tanstack/query-core` (and re-exported through the framework adapters).
   - Updated [`QueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L127-L149) in [types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-core/src/types.ts) to allow returning a [`PersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L72-L79).
   - Updated [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L603-L613) in [query.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-core/src/query.ts) to detect restored snapshot markers and adopt the restored query state (`status`, `error`, `dataUpdateCount`, `dataUpdatedAt`, `errorUpdateCount`, `errorUpdatedAt`, `fetchFailureCount`, `fetchFailureReason`, `fetchMeta`, `isInvalidated`, `fetchStatus: 'idle'`, and infinite-query `pages`/`pageParams`) without triggering normal fetch success/settled cache callbacks.

2. **Updated Single-Query and Bulk Fine-Grained Restoration in [`experimental_createQueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L172-L505)**:
   - Updated [`persisterFn`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L283-L343) in [createPersister.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts) to return [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L81-L96) with the full persisted state so restored queries immediately preserve failure counters, timestamps, invalidation flags, refetch-error state, and infinite-query pagination state during mount.
   - Updated [`restoreQueries`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L367-L450) and added [`reconcileRestoredQueryState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L82-L157) to rebuild cached queries with their full persisted state and independently merge data freshness (`dataUpdatedAt`) and error freshness (`errorUpdatedAt`) when reconciling with existing in-memory queries.

3. **Added Tests**:
   - Added unit and integration tests in [query.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-core/src/__tests__/query.test.tsx), [createPersister.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/__tests__/createPersister.test.ts), [react-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/react-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx), and [preact-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2yyrhceq/packages/preact-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx).
